title: Long Larkspur Residence and the Assisted Living Returned-Payment Charge
content:
**Resident Handbook — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement.** Long Larkspur residence lowers the returned-payment charge.

**Residence** is counted in whole months up to the handling date from the move-in date of the customer's Larkspur independent living residency, under the Independent Living Residency Agreement, when the assisted living admission came from Larkspur independent living, and from the assisted living move-in date otherwise. A whole month is completed each time the count reaches the same day of the month as the starting date.

| Larkspur residence on the handling date | Share of the charge |
|---|---|
| 60 whole months or more | 0.9 |
| 24 whole months or more but under 60 | 0.95 |
| Under 24 whole months | No reduction |

The share multiplies the charge before it is rounded once to the cent.

### Cases (hypothetical)

- Independent living move-in 1 June 2020, assisted living admission from that residency in 2025, handling date 1 June 2026: 72 whole months — 0.9.
- Admission from home, assisted living move-in 15 January 2024, handling date 14 January 2026: 23 whole months — no reduction; on 15 January 2026, 24 whole months — 0.95.
